tasks.subject: Task 1: Foundation — DS tokens, fonts, cleanup sweep

**Files:** create app/fonts.ts; rewrite app/globals.css + tailwind.config.js; modify app/layout.tsx, package.json, netlify.toml, .gitignore, ThemeToggle, common-icons; delete ~30 files per plan Task 1 list.

**Acceptance Criteria:** build+jest pass; paper/night-field grounds; Hanken/Newsreader/JetBrains via next/font, Inter gone; ThemeToggle on inline icons; next-intl/chart.js/react-chartjs-2/playwright/axe-core uninstalled; .eyebrow/.display/.lead/.link-quiet component classes exist; dark --text-body = stone-300 (DS-6).

**Verify:** npm run build && npx jest --ci; grep -r 'next-intl|ProjectMapOriginal|icons/sprite' app components lib → no matches.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Background engine — overlay generator + ContourBackdrop
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Generate drafted-contour + comet-ignition overlays (2 watersheds x 2 themes), strip legacy SMIL, expose background via one client ContourBackdrop component.

**Files:** create scripts/generate-overlays.mjs (port style-explorations/build.js), scripts/strip-smil.mjs, components/ui/ContourBackdrop.tsx; modify hooks/useThemeBackground.ts, AnimatedContourBackground.tsx, package.json, tests.

**Acceptance Criteria:** 4 overlay SVGs (routes pathLength=1 draft 3s; comets head r5 + 12 followers, speeds 70-150 u/s, fade ~8s integer-locked); theme table dark earth-400/river-200+400 vs light earth-700/river-700+500; glow-trace count 0; reduced-motion suppression intact; 4 pages wired to ContourBackdrop.

**Verify:** node scripts/generate-overlays.mjs && npm run build && npx jest --ci; grep -c glow-trace public/images/american_river_contour_bwn.svg → 0.

